The procurement includes the delivery of 10 production areas (3 priority 1 production areas and 7 priority 2 production areas) which are defined in more detail in Appendix 1 Technical requirements and Appendix 1.1 Production areas. This procurement forms part of the NLS' preparedness for the situation where aerial images cannot be obtained from all production areas due to GNSS interference. Therefore, the procurement also includes the possibility to order maximum of 5 additional production areas (priority 3 production areas). The production areas from which these priority 3 production areas are selected are indicated in Section 4 of the Appendix 1. NLS does not commit to purchasing any priority 3 production areas from the supplier under this procurement. If NLS orders priority 3 production areas, the supplier shall have the right to refuse to accept such orders. The object of the procurement and the production areas are described in more detail in Appendix 1 and Appendix 1.1. See also chapters 10 and 11 of the Appendix A Contract. However, the contract shall enter into force no earlier than when there is no impediment to its implementation within the meaning of the public procurement legislation, such as a prohibition on enforcement. The contract shall terminate without separate notice once the supplier has delivered all products ordered by the NLS and both parties have fulfilled all their obligations under the contract. The provisions concerning termination of the contract are set out in chapter 22 of the Appendix A Contract.
